Description:: Arduino branded ESP32 Board (Code will not work with generic ESP32 family devices)
5 segement LED bar graph (any colours you prefer. I used one with 3x green bars, 1x yellow bar, 1x red bar)
2.5a-3a Glass tube fuse with some sort of holder (Use wire thicker than your fuse for runs)
on/off rocker style (or your prefence) for device power on and off
100mm Arcade style push buttons with LEDs
PCB button switch: For turning 5 segment display on to see battery level
TM1637 4-digit 7-segment display (2x of two diffent colours for each teams time keeping)
you can also find them local at jaycar
